newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 23.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Personal income tax revenues reach 19.3 billion yuan ($2.3 billion) in 1996, an increase of 6.2 billion yuan over 1995.
- Beijing had 1,300 chain stores with sales value of more than three billion yuan in 1996.
- Shanghai is building a new natural gas factory with total investment of five billion yuan.
- China's electronics market capacity is seen reaching more than one trillion yuan by the year 2000.
- Tobacco purchases reach 2.375 million tonnes in 1996.
- Output value of China's electronics industry output totals 298.2 billion yuan in 1996, up 20.7 percent compared with 1995. Sales reached 194.7 billion yuan last year, up 18 percent from 1995.
- China and Taiwan shipping sectors reach consensus on technical issues of lifting a decades-old ban on direct shipping links between the two sides.
